name: The Alchemist
description: A fable about Santiago, an Andalusian shepherd boy who travels to Egypt in search of a treasure. First published in Portuguese in 1988; this is the English edition.

name: Nineteen Eighty-Four
description: Orwell's 1949 dystopian novel about Winston Smith, a low-ranking Party member living under constant surveillance in Oceania.

name: The Sorrow of War
description: A novel by Vietnamese author Bao Ninh, following Kien, a former North Vietnamese soldier who recalls the war and the loss of his youth. English translation by Phan Thanh Hao.

name: Novel Without a Name
description: A 1991 novel by Vietnamese writer Duong Thu Huong in which a soldier named Quan travels home across a country marked by the war. English translation by Nina McPherson and Phan Huy Duong.

name: Rich Dad Poor Dad
description: A personal finance book that contrasts the money habits of the author's two father figures, and argues for building assets rather than relying on a salary.

name: The Lean Startup
description: Eric Ries describes a build-measure-learn method for launching products with limited resources, using small experiments to test business ideas early.

name: Zero to One
description: Notes on startups drawn from Peter Thiel's Stanford course, arguing that the best companies create something new instead of copying existing models.

name: Good to Great
description: A research-based study of eleven companies that made a lasting leap from average results to sustained outperformance, and what they had in common.

name: Clean Code
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship covering naming, functions, comments, formatting, error handling and refactoring, with Java examples.

name: Introduction to Algorithms, 4th Edition
description: A comprehensive university textbook on algorithms and data structures, covering sorting, graph algorithms, dynamic programming and NP-completeness.

detail.author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein

name: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
description: Explains the principles behind reliable, scalable and maintainable data systems, including storage engines, replication, partitioning and stream processing.

name: The Pragmatic Programmer, 20th Anniversary Edition
description: Practical advice on everyday software development, from debugging and testing to automation and career habits. Fully revised for the 20th anniversary.

name: Apple MacBook Air 13-inch (M1)
description: 13.3-inch Retina laptop with the Apple M1 chip (8-core CPU), 8 GB unified memory and a 256 GB SSD. Fanless design, runs macOS.

name: Lenovo ThinkPad T470
description: 14-inch business laptop with an Intel Core i5-7300U, 8 GB RAM and a 256 GB SSD. Includes the ThinkPad TrackPoint pointing stick.

name: Dell Latitude 5480
description: 14-inch business laptop with an Intel Core i5-7300U, 8 GB RAM and a 256 GB SSD.

name: HP EliteBook 840 G8
description: 14-inch business laptop with an 11th-generation Intel Core i5-1135G7, 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD.

name: Samsung Galaxy A34 5G
description: 6.6-inch Super AMOLED display with a 120 Hz refresh rate, MediaTek Dimensity 1080 chipset, 48 MP main camera with OIS and a 5,000 mAh battery. IP67 rated.

name: Apple iPhone 15 128GB
description: 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with Dynamic Island, A16 Bionic chip, 48 MP main camera and a USB-C port.

name: Google Pixel 8 128GB
description: 6.2-inch OLED display with a 120 Hz refresh rate, Google Tensor G3 chip, 50 MP main camera and a 4,575 mAh battery. Google promises 7 years of updates.

name: Samsung Galaxy A15
description: 6.5-inch Super AMOLED display with a 90 Hz refresh rate, MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, 50 MP main camera and a 5,000 mAh battery.
